name: First drive
description: A one-minute film of a rover leaving its lander on the Moon, in eight shots. The scene was built and animated in Blender and is drawn as you watch by SoftN: sunlight and the light the ground throws back, shadows, a lens with a focus. Space plays and stops; the arrow keys go from shot to shot. Made for a desktop graphics card (it lowers its own quality on a slower machine); 27 MB.
author: SoftN
